method.deduplication: First isolate per subject per organism per period (CLSI M39). Kept 86 of 95 isolates between 2025-01-01 and 2025-12-29 (9.5% removed as repeats) across 64 subject(s). 5 of them (5.3%) carried no subject identifier and were kept as distinct, since repeat sampling cannot be detected without one.
